mapper.select: SELECT v.page_path, SUM(v.view_count) AS view_count, 0.0 AS percent FROM ( SELECT page_path, view_count FROM page_view_hourly_stat WHERE stat_hour >= #{startTime} AND stat_hour < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) UNION ALL SELECT page_path, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM page_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY page_path ) v GROUP BY v.page_path ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.country, SUM(v.view_count) AS view_count, 0.0 AS percent FROM ( SELECT country COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS country, view_count FROM page_view_country_daily_stat WHERE stat_date >= DATE(#{startTime}) AND stat_date < DATE(DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS country, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM page_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ) v GROUP BY v.country ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(v.stat_hour, #{format}) AS label, SUM(v.view_count) AS view_count FROM ( SELECT stat_hour, view_count FROM page_view_hourly_stat WHERE page_path = #{pagePath} AND stat_hour >= #{startTime} AND stat_hour < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS DATETIME) AS stat_hour, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM page_view_log WHERE page_path = #{pagePath} AND visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS DATETIME) ) v GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(v.stat_hour, #{format}) AS label, SUM(v.view_count) AS view_count FROM ( SELECT stat_hour, view_count FROM page_view_hourly_stat WHERE stat_hour >= #{startTime} AND stat_hour < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS DATETIME) AS stat_hour, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM page_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS DATETIME) ) v GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
